Glad you're excited, Salvador. Your 40T ships December 14, and the team will answer you on the deposit tomorrow.

One quick question before you go. You're already on the Loto early bird and you have a 40T coming. What made you want to add more Loto units on top of that?
No I just have that one unit reserve and the magic 40

You're right, my mistake. One Loto reserved on the $20 deposit, plus the 40T. That's the checkout you'll finish tomorrow once the deposit is applied.

Thanks for putting me straight, Salvador. Out of curiosity, what drew you to the Loto alongside the 40T, the solo-block shot or something else?

I can't confirm the Loto terms from here myself. If you'd like, I'll add it to your ticket, so the team covers how the 2x works and for how long when they apply your deposit tomorrow. Then you'll have the full picture before you check out.

Read the magic miner 40t page

Done, Salvador. The 2x question is on your ticket with the deposit, so you'll get all three answers together tomorrow.

Taking the time to think it over is the right call. A second 40T is the most hashrate per dollar we sell, and it would sit next to the one you already know. Once the team has answered, tell me which way you're leaning and I'll put the numbers side by side and build whichever cart you pick.
Sounds good. Yea I also like the idea of earning doge and bitcoin at the same time
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual

Then the H15 Dual is the one that does both. It's $799 and mines Bitcoin at about 15 TH/s and Dogecoin/Litecoin at 1.08 GH/s at the same time, on roughly 500 W.

To be straight about the trade-off, a second 40T is the same $799 and gives you far more Bitcoin hashrate. The H15 gives up some of that so you get the Doge side as well.

Both are good picks. Have a think, and I'll build whichever one you want once the team has answered you.

That helps you weigh it, Salvador. I can't confirm the Loto's hashrate or pricing myself, so I won't put numbers on it. If it does come in at 12 TH/s, the 2x is what has to make up the gap against a 15 TH/s H15 or a second 40T.

The team's answer on how the 2x works and how long it lasts should settle it. Once you have that, I'll put all three side by side for you.
Sounds good thank you

You're welcome, Salvador. Your questions on the deposit, the link and the 2x are all on one ticket. The answers will come in this chat and by email.

Your 40T is on track for December 14. Have a good evening.
I’ll come back tomorrow
Sounds good, Salvador. Take care, and talk tomorrow.
